data.action: 单手扶全息沙盘下达指令，指尖划过战线光点，颈侧耳机泛蓝光，银灰眼眸锐利坚定
data.camera: medium shot, low angle, holographic display glow, commanding presence
data.description: 【共和国防线地下指挥室·深夜】全息沙盘的幽蓝光束切开黑暗，身着蓝色共和国军装的蕾娜立于指挥桌前，军帽檐下的银白长发泛着冷冽光泽。她单手扶着全息投影边缘，颈侧的Para-RAID秘话耳机亮起微光，银灰色的双眸倒映着战线光点，果决地下达一道道指令——那是既是温柔又绝不容侵犯的指挥官威严。
data.lighting: 全息沙盘幽蓝光束自下而上勾勒军装轮廓与银发冷光
data.location: 共和国防线地下作战指挥室
data.promptProse: Vladilena Milize from 86 -Eighty Six- stands in a dim underground command room at night, wearing her blue San Magnolia military uniform with a peaked cap. Her long silver hair spills over her shoulders as she leans one hand on a glowing holographic strategy table, blue light washing up her composed face and silver-grey eyes. A Para-RAID headset glows faintly on her neck while she issues calm, resolute orders across the glowing front-line markers. Medium shot with dramatic under-glow, cinematic lighting, detailed background of dark console banks.
data.title: 芙拉蒂蕾娜 · 月光指挥室的秘话同调·「这里是我的声音，也永远是你们的」
